name: Election And Predestination
overview: Scripture reveals that God, before the foundation of the world, chose believers in Christ to be holy and blameless, demonstrating His sovereign election (Ephesians 1:4). This divine foreknowledge includes predestining believers to be conformed to the image of Jesus, the firstborn among many brothers (Romans 8:29). Salvation is by God's grace through faith, a gift not earned by human effort (Ephesians 2:8), and those given to Christ by the Father will certainly come to Him and never be rejected (John 6:37). Together, these verses affirm God's purposeful plan in election and predestination centered on Christ's redemptive work.
